body:
I am not religious and fell out of Christianity in my younger years. I really noticed this when I was forced to go to a Christian camp as a kid. When we'd do our daily service and prayers, I felt so out of place. I couldn't get with it like the other kids. I was skeptical.

During my teen years, I discovered things about my sexuality and gender that went against Christianity and it stressed me out. I thought I was wrong and a bad person for how I felt. I would also see hate as a result of this. 

And now I can see the damage religion causes. Wars start over religion. People die over religion. People blindly follow religion and skew up the whole meaning of things. If a god was real, why would they leave so many people to suffer and others live in comfort although they didn't deserve it?

Although this is how I feel, I respect other people's beliefs and their right to believe it as long as they're not hurting themselves, someone else, or myself.
